description: NaMg₁₄YO₁₆ is alpha Po-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.30 Å. There are seven inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.17 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.21 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.34 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.21 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.26 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.20 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one YO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.27 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.17 Å) and two longer (2.25 Å) Y-O bond lengths. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one Y atom to form OYMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six OYMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six OYMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six OYMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. There are two shorter (2.09 Å) and two longer (2.18 Å) O-Mg bond lengths. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve OYMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-9°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent Y atoms to form OY₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OY₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OYMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OY₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OY₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OYMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, four Mg, and one Y atom to form ONaYMg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONaYMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OYMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONaYMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OYMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°.
